name: the laundromat
intro: Washer 3. Moth's jacket is in there, behind the glass, one cycle from done.
Every machine is waiting for something. So is everyone sitting here.

pages: PURCHASE LOGGED TO YOUR IDENTITY. IDENTITY NOT FOUND. PURCHASE LOGGED ANYWAY.
failure: NO TOKEN DETECTED. NO SOAP DISPENSED. ATTEMPT LOGGED.

readables.name: REGISTRY NOTICE
pages: LAUNDRY LEFT OVER 72 HOURS IS RECORDED AS ABANDONED PROPERTY.
ABANDONED PROPERTY IS SCANNED FOR IDENTITY AND FORWARDED TO THE REGISTRY.

readables.name: LOST SOCKS
pages: A board of single socks, pinned up by FOLD-O. Under a grey one, a note: "Owner may claim by describing the other one."
Under it, another hand: "it was grey." Under that, FOLD-O's neat print: "nice try."

people.name: WAITING
talk: Washer 1 is mine. Six shirts. All of them.
This is my seventh. It is not a shirt. It is a towel with ambition.
Every slot the lights dip, three machines start, the breaker gives up and we all start over.
I have watched it eleven times. It is the most reliable thing in my life.
If you sort that breaker out, mine are the blue ones. Not that I am asking. I am asking.

people.name: FOLD-O
talk: I fold. Forty-one thousand shirts so far. Nobody has ever folded me.
I do not mind. I would not fit in a drawer.
Nothing has come out of a washer since Tuesday. I have refolded this towel two hundred times.
It is the best-folded towel in the district. Possibly the city.
Socks I do not fold. Socks I pair. Most days I fail.
The board by the window is my failures. I pinned them up. It helps.

people.name: REGULAR
talk: Washer 2 is mine. Since Tuesday.
At my age you stop waiting for things to finish. You just visit them.
The jacket in 3? A young person brought it in. Paid nine cycles, said nobody searches a wash, and ran.
I said nobody searches me either, dear. Nobody listened to that either.
SUDS starts the paid one when a machine finishes. That is the whole trouble. Nothing in here finishes.
Except me, eventually. Do not look like that, it is a joke. Mostly.

people.name: NIGHT SHIFT
talk: Zzz...
...if four finishes, wake me. If four does not finish, also do not wake me.
...I work nights. I wash days. I sleep in between. Here.
...nobody verifies a bench...
